_comment: Verify I-press inventory OPEN path. Mirrors the loop instruction 'this I-press thing not working' — capture before + after press, assert screen transitions to 'inventory'.
_close_path_note: The TOGGLE-CLOSE path (press I while inventory is up to pop) cannot be reliably scripted: Godot's Input.is_action_just_pressed flag persists across synchronous step_runner advances until the next frame yield, where _poll_input then re-fires ui_open_inventory and re-pushes the screen. Live play does NOT have this issue because the freeze gate skips _poll_input across real frames. To verify the close path, run the game manually with `./scripts/play.sh aldenmere` and press I twice.
